verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents many end-user engineering skills (TDD, triage, grilling, setup-per-repo) and confirms skills are copied as editable files, but nowhere shows a spec, template, or meta-skill for authoring/packaging a brand-new skill itself. Missing for 10: any documented 'create-skill' template, SKILL.md authoring spec, or meta-skill guiding an agent through building and packaging a new skill end-to-end.
